title: A Surprise Party
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / 庆祝生日 / make a wish
passage: Tom's birthday is on October 5th. His friends plan a surprise party at his home. They buy balloons, chocolate and a big cake. When Tom comes in, everyone shouts, "Happy birthday!"
They sing the birthday song. Tom makes a wish and blows out the candles. "This is the best birthday ever," he says. Everyone enjoys the cake and the games.
vocab: celebrate 庆祝 · surprise 惊喜 · balloon 气球 · chocolate 巧克力 · make a wish 许愿 · blow out 吹灭 · enjoy 享受……的乐趣

questions.why: His friends plan a surprise party at his home.
They buy balloons, chocolate and a big cake.

questions.stem: What does Tom do before he blows out the candles?
questions.why: Tom makes a wish and blows out the candles.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: The party is at Tom's school.
Everyone shouts "Happy birthday!" when Tom comes in.
Tom thinks it is a bad birthday.
questions.why: This is the best birthday ever.

sections.title: 三、选词填空（每词限用一次）

questions.stem: They buy ____, chocolate and a big cake.

questions.why: 主语第三人称单数，动词加 s：blows。
